### Shared Utilities Strategy
- **Single `three` instance** — every game imports the same `three` package, so `EffectComposer`/`UnrealBloomPass` addons resolve identically across all 14 titles.
- **Import convention** (enforced in `AGENTS.md`): shared code via absolute `/shared/<name>.js`, siblings via relative `./`. Shared never imports from a game folder.
- **The six mandatory VFX systems are implemented once** in `shared/vfx.js` and reused by every game — trauma-based camera shake, pooled 500-cap particles, hit-stop timescale, motion trails, shockwave rings, floating score text.
- **Strict teardown** — `Game.destroy()` disposes every tracked geometry/material/texture plus a full scene sweep, and disposes the composer + renderer.
